# SYNTHETIC FIXTURE ONLY

All numbers, keys, retrieval timestamps and vintages are invented test inputs.
They are not ECB, Bundesbank or Destatis observations. Four tiny CSVs exercise the
ECB SDMX-CSV **core-column shape**, not a verified live source response. The
quarterly fixture is a normalized handoff, not a claim about Destatis CSV layout.
No fixture observations can enter the blocked real-coverage report. Hash sidecars
bind exact bytes. The absent March rate month is deliberate; leap-day daily data
and missing CPI year-ago pairs exercise calendar logic without interpolation.
